title: Complaint Phone
description: The complainant's RAW phone number. It is here, in its own collection, because a Firestore get returns the WHOLE document and the rules cannot redact a field. If the raw phone sat on the complaint document, then every staff member who can read that complaint would also read the citizen's number, whether they needed it or not. The complaint document keeps a masked copy for the inspector's reference. Only district staff read this collection.
x-docIdRule: The document id is the complaint id, so the phone is found by the same key as the complaint.
x-writes: userapp: create, at the same moment it creates the complaint
x-read-rule: Only the DDO and the TDO may read a raw phone. An inspector sees complaints.phoneMasked. Same rule as staffPhones. ADR-0005.

complaintId.description: The complaint this phone belongs to. It equals the document id.

phone.description: The RAW phone. Never sent to the driver app. Never sent to the user app. Never written on the complaint document.
